ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rhombus $ABCD$, if $ \angle A = \angle B + 40^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus,\\
therefore $\angle A+\angle B=180^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle A=\angle B+40^\circ$,\\
therefore, we find: $\angle B=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
